پرامپت رو با عکس خودتون و یه شات از پیجتون بدین به gimini یا chat gpt👇

Use the Instagram screenshot and the portrait as the ONLY facial reference. Preserve the exact face 100%. Person emerges through a torn paper effect (3D) near center-right, holding edges naturally, black background behind. Keep Instagram interface (profile, bio, buttons, posts), add rounded profile card bottom-right. Style: ultra-photorealistic, realistic paper texture, natural lighting, soft depth of field, 4K. Negative: different face, beauty filter, stylized, cartoon, anime, illustration, altered features, extra fingers, wrong hair/eyes, blurry, low quality, eye banner, multiple faces, identity drift.
